name: Bleed
description: This weapon applies the Bleed status effect to its victim.

name: Clearance {VAL}
description:
This gear requires the pilot to be at the specified License Level of {VAL} or above to use.

This acts as a recommendation to restrict items for specific levels of play.

name: Charges {VAL}
description:
This weapon has {VAL} charge(s) that are expended upon firing. Each charge can be reloaded via a quick action unless otherwise specified. A weapon that has this tag and no charges left cannot fire. Unless otherwise specified, one charge is expelled per fire.

The amount of charges is further increased by the Pilot's Engineering level halved, rounded down.
